spec.text: High-end 3D animated feature film still, stylized but detailed, in the manner of a modern animated adventure movie (subsurface skin, painterly textures, volumetric light). A treasure hunter in her 30s, sun-worn linen shirt, leather satchel, short dark hair, steps from a wooden rowboat onto a wild volcanic island shore at golden hour and glances back over her shoulder toward the camera. In her hand an antique brass magnetic compass. Storm clouds breaking behind her, wet black sand, sea spray. Warm cinematic lighting. No text.
